incidents.name: Elephant Money Reserve ELEPHANT spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: The Reserve minted and redeemed TRUNK against ELEPHANT valued at the PancakeSwap ELEPHANT/WBNB spot price, so the attacker flash-loaned WBNB and BUSD to pump ELEPHANT, minted TRUNK at the inflated valuation, dumped ELEPHANT and redeemed the TRUNK back out of the collapsed reserve.

sources.ref: src/test/2022-04/Elephant_Money_exp.sol (20220412 ElephantMoney - Flashloan & Price Oracle Manipulation, lost $11.2 million)

onchain review: Reserve 0xd520a3b47e42a1063617a9b6273b206a07bdf834 (unverified on BscScan) created 2022-02-16 by 0x16e76819ac1f0dfbecc48dfe93b198830e0c85eb (Elephant Money deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0xe552133cc829a7f7e98e349763fac7ab0f3828b0; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, so the code was 54.8 days old; mint()/redeem() on this contract are the calls the DeFiHackLabs PoC drives

incidents.name: Elephant Status unprotected sweep()
incidents.notes: The Elephant Status contract exposes an unprotected sweep() that pushes its accumulated WBNB into the reserve and moves the ELEPHANT price, which the attacker cycled inside PancakeV3 flash loans.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x8cf0a553ab3896e4832ebcc519a7a60828ab5740 created 2022-09-23T23:47:32Z by 0x16e76819ac1f0dfbecc48dfe93b198830e0c85eb, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xbbcc139933d1580e7c40442e09263e90e6f1d66d; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
